Maple Cinnamon Protein Smoothie

A creamy, frosty blend of banana, Greek yogurt and maple-cinnamon protein, finished with a quick maple drizzle. Breakfast or post-workout snack, sorted.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
5 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
7

Ingredients

  • 1 frozen banana
  • ½ cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt
  • 1 scoop maple-cinnamon protein powder
  • ½–1 cup cold water or milk
  • Ice, as needed
  • Cinnamon, to taste
  • Drizzle: 1 tsp maple syrup mixed with a pinch of cinnamon

Amounts are scaled from 1 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Add frozen banana, Greek yogurt, protein powder, cinnamon, ice and ½ cup water or milk to a blender.
  2. Blend until smooth and creamy. Add more liquid a splash at a time until it reaches your favorite thickness.
  3. Mix the maple syrup with a pinch of cinnamon.
  4. Pour smoothie into a glass and drizzle the maple-cinnamon syrup over the top. Finish with a little extra cinnamon and enjoy.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
